currentCard.prompt: Какой орган является крупнейшей железой в теле взрослого человека?

answers.note: Островки Лангерганса в поджелудочной железе выделяют инсулин и глюкагон.
Передняя доля гипофиза вырабатывает гормон роста и пролактин.
Кора надпочечников вырабатывает кортикостероиды, включая кортизол.
Печень производит желчь, которая помогает эмульгировать жиры в тонкой кишке.

currentCard.explanation: Печень — крупнейшая железа тела взрослого человека. Она производит желчь, которая помогает эмульгировать жиры в тонкой кишке.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: Accessory Organs in Digestion

literal.prompt: Какой орган является крупнейшей железой в теле взрослого человека?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 23.6 L35 directly gives liver as largest gland in adult context. All options are genuine glandular organs: pancreatic tissue and islets at23.6 L64,L68, pituitary at17.3 L32-L35 and adrenal gland cortex at17.3 L97. Key3 is independently supported; grammar and row comparability pass. However MAIN repeats current34 liver size-superlative recognition; see explicit peer defect.

absoluteLevel.ground: Liver as the largest gland is a familiar broad adult school-anatomy fact. The other labels are real glands; no obscure date, calculation, specific hormonal detail or professional training is required to answer MAIN. The more specific hormone facts appear only after answering as teaching notes. EASY does not cure the duplicate-main defect.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Liver bile helps emulsify fats in the small intestine.
correctNoteExtraFact.beyondPromptKey: A physiological secretion/function fact in addition to size ranking; explanation overlap and peer13 MAIN overlap of note alone are permitted.

defects.ground: Current34 asks which is the largest internal human organ, answer liver.55 asks which is the largest human gland, answer liver. Both use the same organ-size superlative recognition as MAIN; substituting the nested comparison class glands for internal organs does not give a sufficiently independent fact under the catalog semantic-diversity rule. This is a near duplicate, not a claim that the two sentences are literally identical or logically equivalent in isolation. The adult qualifier adds no new tested relation.
defects.requiredAction: One directed source-backed replacement MAIN for55 with an independent EASY fact, preserving frozen ID/topic/order/difficulty/correctIndex. Avoid simply rephrasing size ranking or changing to bile-production MAIN already tested by13. Reassess changed whole card and relevant peers; do not edit34 or54 in this reader scope.
